title: Concrescence and the Category of the Ultimate

statements.text: Concrescence is the growing together of many prehensions into one new actual occasion, the production of novel togetherness. Its principle, the Category of the Ultimate, is creativity: the many, which are the universe taken disjunctively, become one novel occasion, which then stands among the many it leaves. The many become one, and are increased by one.

sources.quote: The many become one, and are increased by one.
the 'production of novel togetherness' is the ultimate notion embodied in the term 'concrescence.'
